decisions.label: Genomic DNA
decisions.description: The DNA that is part of the normal chromosomal complement of an organism.

verification.note: NCIT:C95940 Genomic DNA; exact label match.

decisions.label: Metagenomic
decisions.description: Derived from or associated with material collected from an environmental sample.

verification.note: NCIT:C201925 Metagenomic; exact label match. General qualifier describing material from an environmental sample.

decisions.label: Metatranscriptomic
decisions.description: Derived from or associated with transcripts from an environmental sample.

verification.note: NCIT:C43234 Not Reported; standard NCIT qualifier.

decisions.label: Transcriptome
decisions.description: The complete set of RNA transcripts that are produced by the genome, under specific circumstances or in a specific cell.

decisions.label: Viral RNA
decisions.description: The RNA that originates from a virus.

verification.note: NCIT:C204811 Viral RNA; exact label match.
